description:
We're building a practical, data-driven tool using NASA Earth observation datasets (soil moisture, precipitation, temperature) to provide actionable crop and climate insights for farmers. 

My background covers Python, backend APIs, data pipelines, and UI prototyping. Looking for teammates with frontend, UI/UX design, or data science/GIS skills, as well as anyone passionate about space data and pitch storytelling. Let’s collaborate and build an impactful project!
summary: Field Shift is an innovative, farmer-centered decision-support web application designed for the NASA International Space Apps Challenge. Its core mission is to bridge petabytes of raw NASA Earth Observation data directly into actionable, farm-level insights. By moving away from vulnerable continuous monocultures, Field Shift synthesizes complex satellite telemetry into three explainable, multi-season crop rotation strategies that actively restore soil health, conserve depleted groundwater, and build long-term climate resilience.
details: Integrated NASA Missions & Data Streams NASA SMAP: Monitors root-zone (0–100 cm) and surface soil moisture to predict irrigation needs and water deficits early. NASA/JAXA GPM & IMERG: Tracks high-resolution rainfall rates, dry-spell lengths, and storm/erosion hazards. NASA/USGS Landsat 8 & 9: Utilizes 30-meter multispectral reflectance and NDVI to map historical crop vigor and post-harvest bare soil. NASA POWER API: Computes daily solar radiation, temperature extremes, Growing Degree Days (GDD), heat stress days, and frost risks NASA ECOSTRESS: Measures the 70-meter Evaporative Stress Index (ESI) to validate multi-tier canopy cooling benefits Location Input: Interactive Leaflet satellite map for dropping a pin or selecting benchmark agro-climatic zones (e.g., Vidarbha, Punjab, US Corn Belt, Mediterranean Spain). Data Collection: Automated programmatic queries fetching live data from NASA POWER and calibrated telemetry streams Stress Diagnosis: Evaluates root-zone moisture percentiles, rainfall adequacy, thermal loads, and canopy vigor. Strategy Comparison: Generates 3 distinct multi-season crop rotation plans complete with scientific evidence, economic benefits, information gaps, and local risk reviews Interactive Dashboard: Features real-time gauges, dual-axis trends, moisture curves, and printable extension advisories.
